titulo: I am looking for someone who knows
intro: Choose indicative or subjunctive in relative clauses according to whether the person or thing is identified.
p.antecedente.consejo: In «busco un guía que sepa», the antecedent is «un guía». If it is not identified, subjunctive.
p.identificado.consejo: If the speaker has someone specific in mind, it is «identified»: indicative.
p.vacante.consejo: It is feminine: «la vacante». The v and b sound the same: ba-KAN-te.
p.requisito.consejo: It is masculine: «el requisito». You say «cumplir los requisitos».
p.candidato.consejo: The feminine is «candidata». The d is soft: kan-di-DA-to.
p.plaza.consejo: It has two meanings: «una plaza de trabajo» and «la plaza del pueblo». The z sounds «th».
p.temporal.consejo: It does not change in the feminine: «contrato temporal», «plaza temporal». The stress is at the end: tem-po-RAL.
p.guía.consejo: «El guía» is a man; «la guía» is a woman or a book. It has an accent: GI-a.
p.ascensor.consejo: It is written with «sc»: as-then-SOR. In America you also say «elevador».
p.informe.consejo: It is masculine: «el informe». Do not mix it up with «informal» or «informar».
b1.texto:
A relative clause describes a person or thing. The choice of mood often depends on whether the speaker presents its antecedent as **identified and real**, or as **unknown, sought or nonexistent**.

- **Identified, presented as real: indicative.** Conozco a una periodista que **trabaja** en Quito. The speaker has a particular journalist in mind.
- **Unknown or sought: subjunctive.** Busco a una periodista que **trabaje** en Quito. The speaker has not identified that person.
- **No such person or thing exists: subjunctive.** No hay ningún informe que **explique** el resultado.
- **A real but not yet identified item can take the subjunctive.** Necesito un piso que **tenga** ascensor.

The subjunctive does not mean that the person or thing is unreal in the world; it marks how the speaker presents it in this sentence. Compare the context and meaning, not just the noun before **que**.
b2.f0.texto: We are looking for someone who knows the history of the neighbourhood.
b2.f1.texto: I know a guide who works at the museum.
b2.f3.texto: Her name is Lucía and she speaks three languages.
b2.f4.texto: We need a guide who speaks Arabic.
b2.f5.texto: There is no candidate who meets all the requirements.
b2.f6.texto: The position is temporary, although the contract can be renewed.
b2.f7.texto: We value those who have worked in a museum before.
b2.f8.texto: We will interview the candidates who meet these conditions.
b2.f9.texto: The chosen person will work with a team that organises visits for schools.
b4.titulo: Indicative or subjunctive in the relative
b4.texto:
- **Indicative**: the person or thing exists and is identified: conozco a una guía que habla árabe.
- **Subjunctive**: it is sought, wished for or nonexistent: busco una guía que hable árabe; no hay nadie que hable árabe.

**A trick**: ask yourself whether the speaker has someone specific in mind. If so, indicative; if not, subjunctive.
b4.e0.texto: I need a flat that has a lift.
b4.e1.texto: I know a flat that has a lift.
b4.e2.texto: There is no report that explains the result.
b5.f0.texto: The city museum keeps its rooms like a treasure of soft shadows.
b5.f1.texto: Every morning, a guide opens the heavy doors with an old key.
b5.f2.texto: At the entrance, a notice seeks someone who knows the history of the neighbourhood.
b5.f3.texto: The paper yellows in the sun and smells of old ink.
b5.f4.texto: The visitors walk slowly past display cases that hold coins, maps and watches.
b5.f5.texto: Whoever works there will need patience, a good voice and plenty of curiosity.
b5.f6.texto: A young woman, the candidate who knows the streets best, climbs the stairs.
b5.f7.texto: There is no lift that goes up to the room under the roof.
b5.f8.texto: She is looking for a report that explains the origin of the old map.
b5.f9.texto: Then the whole room seems to hold the breath of another century.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: someone not yet known is being sought.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Then you would say «conozco a una guía que habla árabe».
b6.o2.refuerzo: The subjunctive does not say that: it only marks that she is not identified.
b6.pregunta: What is the guide like in «busco una guía que hable árabe»?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: something sought and unidentified takes the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative, for a guide you already know.
b7.o2.refuerzo: It is an infinitive. Here you need a conjugated verb.
b7.pregunta: You have not found him yet: choose the mood.
b8.frase: No hay ningún informe que explique el resultado
b8.traduccion: There is no report that explains the result
b9.frase: Conozco a un guía que ____ árabe.
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: an identified person takes the indicative.
b9.o1.refuerzo: It is subjunctive, for someone you do not know yet.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It is a past subjunctive and does not fit the present.
b9.pregunta: It is someone you already know: choose the mood.
b11.o0.refuerzo: If it did not exist, it would take the subjunctive.
b11.o1: porque el equipo existe y está identificado
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done: it is presented as a real, known group.
b11.o2.refuerzo: The sentence does not speak of the future, but of a real team.
b11.pregunta: In «un equipo que organiza visitas», why the indicative?
b12.frase: No hay nadie que ____ la respuesta.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: what does not exist takes the subjunctive.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative; after «no hay nadie que» comes the subjunctive.
b12.o2.refuerzo: It is an infinitive. Here a conjugated verb goes.
b12.pregunta: Something nonexistent asks for the subjunctive.
p.buscamos.consejo: From «buscar», to look for. Stress on KA: bus-KA-mos.
p.conozca.consejo: Subjunctive of «conocer», to know. The c before o is k, and the z before a is th.
p.necesitamos.consejo: From «necesitar», to need. Stress on TA.
p.hable.consejo: Subjunctive of «hablar», to speak. The h is silent: A-ble.
p.árabe.consejo: It means Arabic, both the language and the people. Stress on A.
p.cumpla.consejo: Subjunctive of «cumplir», to fulfil. Stress on KUM.
p.requisitos.consejo: Plural of «requisito», requirement. Stress on SI.
p.valoramos.consejo: From «valorar», to value. The v sounds like b. Stress on RA.
p.trabajado.consejo: Participle of «trabajar», to work. The j sounds like h. Stress on HA.
p.entrevistaremos.consejo: Future of «entrevistar», to interview. The v sounds like b. Stress on RE.
p.cumplan.consejo: Subjunctive of «cumplir», plural. Stress on KUM: KUM-plan.
p.condiciones.consejo: Plural of «condición», condition. The -ción ending takes the stress.
p.trabajará.consejo: Future of «trabajar», to work. The j sounds like h. Stress on RA.
p.organiza.consejo: From «organizar», to organise. The z is th in Spain. Stress on NI.
p.visitas.consejo: Plural of «visita», visit. The v sounds like b. Stress on SI.
p.escuelas.consejo: Plural of «escuela», school. The ue is a diphthong.
p.tenga.consejo: Subjunctive of «tener», to have. Stress on TEN: TEN-ga.
p.explique.consejo: Subjunctive of «explicar», to explain. The x sounds ks.
p.salas.consejo: Plural of «sala», a room or hall. Stress on SA.
p.pesadas.consejo: Feminine plural of «pesado», heavy. Stress on SA.
p.amarillea.consejo: From «amarillear», to turn yellow. The ll sound is y; the ea is two syllables.
p.vitrinas.consejo: Plural of «vitrina», display case. The v sounds like b. Stress on TRI.
p.guardan.consejo: From «guardar», to keep. The gu before a is gw: GWAR-dan.
p.mapas.consejo: Plural of «mapa», map. Stress on MA: MA-pas.
p.relojes.consejo: Plural of «reloj», clock. The j sounds like h. Stress on LO.
p.necesitará.consejo: Future of «necesitar», to need. Stress on RA.
p.candidata.consejo: Feminine of «candidato». Stress on DA: kan-di-DA-ta.
p.suba.consejo: Subjunctive of «subir», to go up. The b and v sound the same: SU-ba.
p.origen.consejo: Masculine, «el origen». The g before e is h. Stress on RI.
p.contener.consejo: Infinitive of «contener», to hold in. Stress on NER.
p.aliento.consejo: Masculine, «el aliento». The ie is a diphthong: a-LIEN-to.
p.identificada.consejo: Feminine of «identificado», identified. Stress on KA.
p.existe.consejo: From «existir», to exist. The x sounds ks. Stress on IS.
